examples.title: A heading, an action and content
examples.description: A section is a heading with an optional description and action, then its content. Space separates it from the next section; nothing is boxed.

examples.title: A tall section keeps every child
examples.description: The content is a block, so children that clip their overflow are never squeezed inside a flex or scroll parent.
